title: Follow nouns through a short text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the set of words for all three gaps.

parts.prompt: Rina found ___ old map in the library. ___ map showed a road that no longer exists, and there was ___ information about it in the town records.

choice_rationales.A: Old starts with a vowel sound, the reader now knows the map, and information takes little.
choice_rationales.B: Old needs an, and few goes with plural countable nouns.
choice_rationales.C: The first mention needs an, the second mention needs The, and many needs a countable noun.
choice_rationales.D: An is right, but A would suggest a different map.

parts.hint: Check each gap on its own, then read the text again.
parts.correct_explanation: The first mention takes an, the second takes The, and uncountable information takes little.
